sources.name: Leffingwell Odor Dataset (via Pyrfume)
sources.maintainer: Pyrfume Project; original data John Leffingwell, cleaned by Sanchez-Lengeling et al.

rights.dataset_terms: The dataset manifest says use restrictions are in a LICENSE file from Leffingwell/Google; that file was not found in the retrieved checkout. UNRESOLVED: review before redistributing labels.

sources.task: Multi-label descriptor assignment (binary). Reference population: expert-compiled flavor and fragrance descriptors, not a rater panel.
sources.attribution: Odor labels: Leffingwell dataset, cleaned by Sanchez-Lengeling et al., distributed by the Pyrfume project.

chemistry_coverage.stereo_unspecified_note: Stereochemistry is preserved in canonical SMILES; model features ignore it.

label_handling.raw_vs_canonical: Descriptor vocabulary is used as published (no terms merged).
label_handling.missingness: Source lists positive descriptors only. An unlisted descriptor is UNKNOWN; training treats it as negative (positive-unlabeled setting) and the model card states this limitation.
label_handling.aggregation: No rater-level data is available in this source; there is no dispersion or rater count.
